director.p1: Welcome to the Spatial Data Science Center (SDSC) where solutions to many of the World's most pressing problems are being forged through the development of sophisticated statistical methods and the application of new approaches such as GeoAI and machine learning. Our expertise extends to all types of domain areas including health, transportation, voting, crime, housing, retailing, and the environment. Our work is built on the fundamental principle that understanding where these challenges occur is the key to understanding why they occur and how to solve them.
director.p2: The SDSC aims to be a focal point for all the great work that is taking place in spatial data science across many departments at FSU. Whether you're a faculty member wanting to pursue joint research or a funding application, or are interested in becoming an affiliate, or a representative of a government department or private firm needing consulting assistance, or a student interested in being involved in SDSC activities, contact us at stewart.fotheringham@fsu.edu.

research.title: Advancing spatial knowledge and practice
research.intro: The Spatial Data Science Center (SDSC) is committed to developing solutions to some of society's most pressing problems in areas such as health, transportation, crime, poverty and the environment through the power of spatial data analytics.

spatialAnalytics.title: Spatial Analytics
spatialAnalytics.description: Advance spatial statistical and AI methods to better understand spatial processes and enable accurate prediction.

healthWellbeing.title: Health & Wellbeing
healthWellbeing.description: Analyze geographic patterns in health outcomes, risks, and healthcare access for better decision-making and prediction.

environment.title: Environment
environment.description: Monitor, model, and predict environmental changes and natural hazards, and assess their impacts on ecosystems and communities.

voting.title: Voting
voting.description: Measure spatial patterns of voter behavior, electoral processes, and participation disparities.

urban.title: Urban
urban.description: Explore how urban systems, mobility and spatial dynamics influence equity and resilience in cities.

transportation.title: Transportation
transportation.description: Understand travel behavior, enhance mobility systems, and advance equitable and sustainable transportation solutions.

crime.title: Crime
crime.description: Examine crime dynamics, neighborhood contexts, and social inequities shaping public safety.

mgwr.title: Multiscale Geographically Weighted Regression (MGWR)
mgwr.intro: MGWR provides a Windows and macOS interface for calibrating multiscale geographically weighted regression models so you can explore how multi-scale relationships vary across space.

windows.title: MGWR GUI (Windows)
windows.description: Installer package with the latest stable build, examples, and documentation for Windows 10/11 environments.

macos.title: MGWR GUI (macOS)
macos.description: Universal binary for Apple Silicon and Intel Macs with notarized installer and starter projects.
